title: "UpSet_Plot"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ---- Load Required Libraries ----
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(UpSetR)
library(stringr)

# ---- Load Data ----
full_df <- read_csv("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Clinical/Bionano_cohort.csv")

# ---- Clean Character Columns ----
full_df <- full_df %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_trim(.)))

# ---- One-hot Encode Selected Categorical Columns ----
categorical_cols <- c("Origin", "Source")

df_onehot <- full_df %>%
  select(SampleID, all_of(categorical_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SampleID,
    names_to = "Attribute",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value), Value != "") %>%
  unite("AttrValue", Attribute, Value, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = AttrValue,
    values_from = Present,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```


```{r}
# ---- Convert Platform Columns to Binary ----
platform_cols <- c("Bionano", "RNAseq")

df_binary <- full_df %>%
  select(SampleID, all_of(platform_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(platform_cols),
      ~ ifelse(!is.na(.) & . == "Yes", 1, 0)
    )
  )

# ---- Merge One-hot and Platform Data ----
df_combined <- df_binary %>%
  left_join(df_onehot, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(across(-SampleID, ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(across(-SampleID, as.numeric))
```


```{r}
# ---- Convert to Base Data Frame for UpSetR ----
df_combined_base <- df_combined %>%
  select(-SampleID) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ---- Optional: Check Final Matrix ----
print(colnames(df_combined_base))
print(head(df_combined_base))
```


```{r}
# ---- Save UpSet Plot ----
outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/Clinical/UpSetPlot"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

make_upset_plot <- function() {
  upset(
    df_combined_base,
    sets = colnames(df_combined_base),
    nsets = ncol(df_combined_base),
    order.by = "freq",
    keep.order = TRUE,
    main.bar.color = "steelblue",
    sets.bar.color = "gray40",
    text.scale = 2.0
  )
}
make_upset_plot()
```

```{r}
# Save as PNG
png(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "upset_plot.png"),
  width = 1600,
  height = 1200,
  res = 150
)
make_upset_plot()
dev.off()

# Save as PDF
pdf(
  file = file.path(outdir, "upset_plot.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 9
)
make_upset_plot()
dev.off()

cat("UpSet plot script finished successfully\n")
```
